prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a sideswipe while changing lanes in Sugar Land, Texas, and has back strain. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1486; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for agreeing to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.

A: I'd rather not give my full name on the recording, but you can use the claim file.

Q: That's fine. Can you tell me where you were when the accident happened?

A: I was driving on a multi-lane road in Sugar Land, Texas, heading toward the freeway. It was around the middle of the afternoon.

Q: What were you doing right before the collision?

A: I was changing lanes to the right because I needed to exit. I checked my mirror and saw nothing close, so I signaled and started to move over.

Q: Did you see the other vehicle at any point?

A: Not until it was right next to me. It came up in the lane I was moving into and we sideswiped each other. I heard a loud scrape and felt my car jerk.

Q: Did you or the other driver stop afterward?

A: Yes, we both pulled onto the shoulder. We exchanged insurance information and nobody called an ambulance at the scene.

Q: How are you feeling now?

A: My lower back is sore and stiff, mostly when I sit for a long time or get out of the car. I felt it that same evening and it has been getting a little worse each day.

Q: Have you seen a doctor or received any treatment?

A: I went to an urgent care clinic the next morning. They diagnosed a back strain, gave me muscle relaxers, and told me to rest and do physical therapy.

Q: Are you still having trouble with work or daily activities?

A: Yes, lifting and bending are difficult, and I've had to limit how long I drive. I'm trying to keep up with my appointments.

Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add to your statement?

A: No, I think that covers it. I'm willing to provide my medical records if you need them.

Q: Thank you. This concludes the recorded statement.
